name: context-band
description: How full the context window is, as a one-line bar above the prompt, so you know when to /compact or /clear.

warnAtPercent.title: Warm at (% used)
warnAtPercent.description: The bar turns amber once this share of the way to auto-compact is used.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at (% used)
compactAtPercent.description: The bar turns red and suggests /compact once this share of the way to auto-compact is used.

warnAtTokens.title: Warm at (tokens)
warnAtTokens.description: The bar turns amber once the context holds this many tokens, whatever the share. 0 turns it off.

compactAtTokens.title: Compact at (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: The bar turns red and suggests /compact once the context holds this many tokens, whatever the share. 0 turns it off.
